acceptanceCriteria: A real provider document (qualified JavaScript/Playwright receipt or Go test receipt) reaches the REUSED outcome of `corvint test-plan consolidate` end to end, or the spec records why REUSED is synthetic-only and the outcome is narrowed accordingly.
A maintained test drives the real-document path, not a synthetic projection.
body:
Found by the V1-1023 lane (test consolidation planner, TCN-V0, branch claude/v1-1023-consolidation-planner head a8f649cb, build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-08-v1-1023-consolidation-planner.md §Finding).

Expected: a test receipt from a real provider document can be classified REUSED by the consolidation planner.
Actual: REUSED is unreachable end to end. A qualified external JavaScript profile always reads freshness UNKNOWN (`retained-external-app-lifecycle-unverifiable`) and needs a full Playwright tuple; Go test receipts carry no `id`; an unprofiled receipt with an `id` is refused. Reuse is proven only through synthetic projections.

Version: corvint source at lane head a8f649cb on origin/main 388fb832, 2026-10-08.
